create_criteo_dataset: create a CriteoDataset instance to load and preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte advertising data for DLRM training
create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset instance to generate synthetic random or trace-driven input data for DLRM benchmark testing
make_criteo_data_and_loaders: build PyTorch DataLoaders for Criteo dataset with configurable collate wrappers and memory mapping support
make_random_data_and_loader: build PyTorch DataLoaders for random synthetic dataset with offset or length-based sparse feature representation
generate_synthetic_trace: run the main script to profile a trace file, compute stack distance distribution, and generate synthetic LRU trace data
